notes:
Snow Cut 0.1.3.

- Windows: SnowCut_0.1.3_x64-setup.exe installs Snow Cut for the current user; installed copies update from here.
- Android: a debug-signed dev build for sideloading, with the in-app updater; not for Play.

No backend. Changes since 0.1.2:

- chore(release): skicut 0.1.3 (e7efbca)
- g3-ui: frosted surfaces blur in Android web views again, NavBar can float as a pill, an iOS toolbar segment pill keeps its longest label on a phone, and an expanded AdaptiveNav rail opens again (g3techhq/g3-ui@71d6aab, @ebcdb7a)

Built from the local skicut repository (it has no GitHub remote).
